text:
mira (PM): Quick sync: milestone-12 slipped because of the infra KV regression + two enterprise asks to preserve SSO onboarding and billing detail. I recommend we compress scope: MVP = SSO + billing events + Basic API (single-tenant promptstore minimal admin). Defer multi-tenant routing, per-tenant QoS, and analytics to v1.

dan (Eng): Agree on holding off multi-tenant routing. Clarify: basic promptstore = CRUD + CSV import/export only? No replication, no tenant isolation?

mira (PM): Yep, minimal admin and data portability. Shipable and unblock customers who need SSO.

rita (Infra): Multi-tenant routing is the risky piece. With current KV caching assumptions, enabling it now increases 99.9th tail by ~30-50ms. We need at least 4 days of infra work + e2e. Not safe for this GA window.

dan (Eng): Billing shape must be stable. We need a spec for the event envelope before cutting features. If billing events are inconsistent, finance will blow up.

hao (Design): UX compromise: expose a simple tenant dropdown in admin and hide the onboarding wizard. Low effort, keeps the console usable for GA. I can produce wireframes by Tuesday.

emma (Sales): Two large customers asked for tenant isolation. If we ship single-tenant, Sales needs a short commitment note: GA = single-tenant; v1 = multi-tenant + QoS with target date. Otherwise they won't sign.

mira (PM): Will draft customer note. Proposed v1 follow-up: two sprints after GA for multi-tenant, QoS, and analytics.

rita (Infra): We can ship a conservative rate gate to protect the cluster. Example gate config to deploy now:```json
{"per_api_key_rps": 600, "burst_capacity": 150, "fallback_model": "rwd-small"}
```
This limits noisy keys and keeps tail latency predictable.

dan (Eng): OK. If infra ships the gate and provides billing event spec by EOD Wednesday, Eng will freeze the trimmed API surface and reassign owners to harden logging and billing pipeline.

mira (PM): Acceptance criteria for slim MVP:
- SSO (Okta/Google) for admin and API keys
- Billing events emitted for every request (stable envelope)
- Single-tenant promptstore: admin CRUD + import/export only
- Conservative rate-limit gate enabled by default
- Canary healthchecks + rollout policy for GA
If no blockers, Ill update roadmap and notify sales/legal today.

deploy-bot: canary-bot: Canary build queued: milestone-12/trimmed-ga (ci#5012) :rocket:
